about: Guanethidine is supplied six times from January to September 2026 to a 75-year-old man, and it is shown by ingredient name because it has no Australian brand.
Guanethidine is supplied three times from December 2025 to March 2026 to a 67-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history.
No guanethidine is supplied: the record holds ordinary blood pressure medicines and one similar name, guaifenesin cough liquid (Robitussin Chesty Cough), so the criterion is not met.
